blocks.content: Just like sessionStorage, the localStorage object provides different methods to manage data.
In fact, localStorage uses the same methods as sessionStorage.

rows: Stores data in localStorage as key-value pairs.
Retrieves the value associated with a specific key.
Deletes a specific item from localStorage.
